svg.text: Island Colony controller: ESP32 OFF the breadboard
Every connection = 2 male-to-female wires meeting in ONE breadboard column.
Wire 1: female on the ESP32 pin → male in row a. Wire 2: male in row e of the SAME column → female on the part.
ESP32 3V3/GND → TOP rails; link to BOTTOM
Joystick +5V, Encoder +, TFT VCC and LED → +
Joystick GND, Encoder GND, TFT GND → −
NEVER put an ESP32 pin in a rail
Columns count from the left of the breadboard. Leave an empty column between signals. Start with BUILD + 3V3 + GND only, then test.
